summary: Iteration 16 — verified dual auth (JWT cookie OR X-API-Key), /agents/cascade endpoint (3 segments + bogus), CEO report run-now/get, novedades-ticks and the new frontend cascade UX (open-btn, rail-btn, dialog, 3 segments, HITL dialog with 24 rojos, HITL yes/no). Backend 17/17 pytest cases passing, Playwright 14/14 assertions passing. No critical issues.

issues: Canvas2D getImageData warning persists on MatrixRain/Constellation (perf-only, no functional impact — noted in iter 15 as well).

critical_code_review_comments: deps.py cleanly accepts JWT cookie OR bearer OR X-API-Key with a single dependency — good migration pattern.
agents.py `_pick_segment` fallback for unknown segment returns first N orders (q={}); works but could log a warning so callers see they mistyped the segment.
scheduler.py `daily_ceo_report` invokes metrics endpoint with 4 positional None params — brittle if signature changes. Consider calling an internal helper instead of the FastAPI route function.

Copilot.jsx runCascade sends the summary to sendPrompt but doesn't guard against Marcus being mid-response (running=true). Under rapid clicks the cascade could pile up requests. Consider disabling cascade-run while chat is busy.
Right-rail visibility below xl breakpoint: rail button (cascade-rail-btn) becomes inaccessible on tablet/mobile — cascade-open-btn covers it, so acceptable.
test_credentials: qa2@litper.co / Litper!2026 for cookie auth; legacy X-API-Key still accepted.
seed_data_creation: None. Existing seed has ~24 rojos which correctly triggered HITL flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dual-auth is live via /app/backend/deps.py — routes accept both cookie and X-API-Key. Frontend api.js no longer sends X-API-Key. Cascade endpoint returns HITL for red_this_week (24 rojos in seed). Scheduler endpoints: POST /api/agents/ceo-report/run-now → snapshots today's KPIs; GET /api/agents/novedades-ticks?limit=N reads recent 15-min sweeps.
